beats.narration: Llama 4 Scout's config allows over ten million tokens of context. How do its layers handle that, and does a configured maximum tell us anything?
beats.narration_text: Llama 4 Scout: (1) show me which layers use RoPE and which use no position encoding, (2) explain chunked attention, (3) tell me what a token at position 20,000 can actually see in each layer type — from config.json.

props.title: Llama 4, Ten Million Tokens?
thesis: 109B parameters, 17B active. Three of every four layers know position but
see one chunk; the fourth sees everything, with no position at all.

roadmap.label: The pattern
roadmap.body: 36 RoPE chunked layers, 12 NoPE global layers.

roadmap.label: The reach
roadmap.body: What the token at position 20,000 can see.

roadmap.label: The claim
roadmap.body: 10,485,760 is a configured ceiling, not a result.

props.source: Meta AI — The Llama 4 herd (Apr 5, 2025) · Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E config.json

beats.narration: Every four layers, three use rotary positions and attend only within chunks of about eight thousand tokens. The fourth has no position encoding, and sees the whole context.
beats.narration_text: Every four layers, three use rotary positions and attend only within chunks of about eight thousand tokens. The fourth has no position encoding, and sees the whole context.

props.heading: Interleaved RoPE

moves.label: NOPE
moves.detail: Layers 4, 8, 12 … 48: no position encoding, full causal attention.

moves.label: EXPERTS
moves.detail: Mixture of experts: 1 of 16 routed experts per token.

props.keepNote: Only 12 of the 48 layers can look past the current chunk.
props.source: Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E config.json (no_rope_layers [1,1,1,0] repeating) · Meta AI — The Llama 4 herd (Apr 5, 2025)

beats.narration: Rope layers are local: precise positions, blind past their chunk. No-position layers are global: they see everything, with order only from the causal mask.
beats.narration_text: Rope layers are local: precise positions, blind past their chunk. No-position layers are global: they see everything, with order only from the causal mask.

props.heading: Two kinds of attention mask

moves.label: ROPE MASK
moves.detail: Token i sees j if j ≤ i and both sit in the same 8,192-token chunk.

moves.label: NOPE MASK
moves.detail: Token i sees every j ≤ i — no rotation applied.

moves.label: ORDER
moves.detail: NoPE layers get order only from the causal mask itself.

moves.label: GOAL
moves.detail: Meta: interleaving plus attention temperature scaling, for length generalization.

props.keepNote: Long-range information has to travel through the NoPE layers.
props.source: Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E config.json · Meta AI — The Llama 4 herd (Apr 5, 2025) (iRoPE)

beats.narration: Take the token at position twenty thousand. In a rope layer it sees three thousand six hundred seventeen tokens. In a no-position layer, all twenty thousand and one.
beats.narration_text: Take the token at position twenty thousand. In a rope layer it sees three thousand six hundred seventeen tokens. In a no-position layer, all twenty thousand and one.

props.spark: Twelve layers carry the long range.
props.heading: What token 20,000 can see
props.exception: RoPE: 20,000 − 16,384 + 1 = 3,617 tokens. Anything older reaches it only through the 12 NoPE layers.
props.source: Computed from Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E config.json (attention_chunk_size 8192, no_rope_layers) · 0-indexed position

beats.narration: The skeptic's part. Ten million is a ceiling the config allows; Meta says Scout trained at a two hundred fifty-six thousand token context. Quality at length has to be measured.

props.heading: Configured is not measured

moves.label: CEILING
moves.detail: max_position_embeddings 10,485,760 is what the code allows.

moves.label: TRAINED
moves.detail: Pre- and post-trained with a 256K context length.

moves.label: MEASURE
moves.detail: Quality at length needs retrieval and reasoning tests, not perplexity alone.

moves.detail: Llama 4 Community License: open weights with use restrictions.

beats.narration: The verdict. Interleaving position-aware and position-free layers is a real, inspectable design. But a configured maximum is a promise, not evidence. Test at the length you need.
